_comment: Whether GE16 has been called yet (issue #1, story 8; issue #12).
Maintained by hand, like Government Coalition membership and the State
Election Signal: a dissolution is an announced event, not a feed, and
issue #1 puts automatic detection of that kind of change out of scope.
'Called' means the Dewan Rakyat has been dissolved — the act that starts
a Malaysian general election. The Election Commission sets the nomination
and polling days afterwards, so there is a real interval, usually a week
or two, where the election has been called and no polling date exists
yet. The two fields are separate for that reason; do not fill polling_date
with a guess to avoid leaving it null, because the Dashboard reads null as
'not yet set' and says so, which is true, where a wrong date is not.
To update when the Dewan Rakyat is dissolved:
1. Set dissolved_on to the date of the dissolution.
2. Leave polling_date null until the Election Commission announces it,
then set it.
3. Replace source with the announcement you took the dates from.
Nothing else needs to change; the Dashboard derives what it says from
which of these two dates are present.
constitutional_deadline is the last day GE16 can be held. Article 55(3)
and (4) of the Federal Constitution dissolve the Dewan Rakyat five years
after its first sitting — 19 December 2022, so 19 December 2027 — and
require a general election within sixty days of that. It is a fixed
consequence of GE15 and only moves if the Dewan Rakyat is dissolved
early, which is the ordinary case and is what dissolved_on records.
As of 6 August 2026 GE16 has not been called. Dissolution is widely
speculated for late 2026, but speculation is not a date and is not
recorded here.
